protocol.secondary_label: existing strong_producer annotation; not a newly fitted activity threshold
protocol.selection: All 50 cofolds measured; geometry screen then shortest attack distance and physicality QC; angle breaks ties; no activity labels used.
protocol.statistical_unit: enzyme; endpoints and poses are not biological replicates
limitations: Retrospective exploratory panel; labels have been examined previously.
Four endpoints per enzyme provide a small pilot, not a residence-time estimate.
Historical one-Mg step-1 setup; outcome reflects complete assay and expression.
Protein physicality does not validate ligand chemistry; extra clash diagnostics are descriptive.
No calibrated equilibrium probabilities, rate constants, or binding free energies.
Enzymes without qualifying starts are excluded from BioEmu2, not labeled experimentally inactive.
protocol.submission_scope: Only enzymes with at least one physically acceptable pose passing the geometry screen.
